summary: This work-stage/demand extension preserves the existing Annual Planner access, metadata, pairing and revision controls. The changed phase validator accepts optional work-only profiles and legacy unclassified tuples. Local emulator tests pass maximal legacy and profiled create/update payloads. Deployment verification for this extension is tracked separately.

findings.issue: Existing residual: rules validate stored types, bounded ranges, and real calendar values, while compound schedule feasibility near the domain's 1900/2200 boundaries remains a domain validation responsibility. A custom authorized client can store a bounded definition whose generated schedule crosses that supported range. This extension does not change that behavior.
findings.recommendation: The normal save path rejects these schedules. Live subscriptions validate complete joined records and report the affected record rather than sending it to rendering. Review a server-authoritative schedule validator if untrusted editors or wider distribution are introduced.

instance.verification: Parent verified with Firebase CLI during this task.

access.read: Existing active Central user; planner permission view/propose/edit/approve/admin. Absent planner key falls back to studio then settings. Explicit planner none wins.
access.write: Same ACL excluding view. Creator metadata is provenance, not ownership: authorized staff collaborate on shared plans.
access.identity: Creator UID and createdAt equal authenticated UID/request.time at create and remain immutable. updatedByUid/request.time are checked every save. No new roles or permission fields.

wireFormat.reason: Firestore's 1000-expression evaluation ceiling requires compact nested values and an atomic companion adjustment document; domain and UI retain named objects and YYYY-MM-DD strings.
wireFormat.event: Header contains anchorDate as UTC-midnight Timestamp and a pinned templateSnapshot. Manual overrides and excludedMeetingDates live in centralAnnualAdjustments with the same document ID and revision. Both write and delete atomically; getAfter checks enforce pairing.
wireFormat.templatePhases: Map keyed by unique phase ID. Value [name, kind, packedRange]. packedRange = ((offsetDays + 730) * 366 + durationDays - 1) * 6 + originalOrder. Rules require integer 0..3208355; decode offset=floor(packed/2196)-730, duration=floor(packed/6)%366+1, order=packed%6. This represents offsets -730..730, durations 1..366, order 0..5 with no invalid combinations. Optional work profiles use a five-slot tuple [name, kind, packedRange, workStageOrEmpty, demandOrEmpty]. Valid stages are ideation/activation/implementation; demands light/moderate/high. Each slot accepts only its enum or empty string. Five-slot tuples are restricted to preparation/active kinds. Existing three-slot tuples remain accepted and are decoded without either optional field; missing demand is never inferred as light. Malformed lengths/types/enums are rejected on both create and update and by the client decoder.
wireFormat.overrides: Map keyed by stable schedule item ID. Integer value = (startEpochDay + 25567) * 366 + endEpochDay - startEpochDay. Rules require integer >=0 and floor(value/366)+value%366 <=109937. Decode start=floor(value/366)-25567; end=start+value%366. All decoded ranges are real dates within 1900-01-01..2200-12-31 and 1..366 inclusive days.
wireFormat.exclusions: List of integer UTC days since 1970-01-01, inclusive range -25567..84370. Every possible value represents a real calendar date.
wireFormat.metadata: Server timestamps come from the page's actual Firebase compat instance; never a separately bundled SDK. Template library version increments; event snapshots remain pinned until explicitly replaced.
wireFormat.compatibility: No bulk migration or automatic snapshot upgrade. The encoder emits the original three-slot tuple when both fields are absent; optional undefined fields are omitted from domain objects. Stored custom library definitions override bundled starters regardless of version, and existing events retain their saved snapshots until explicitly upgraded. Base-six range packing and all v1 limits are unchanged.

checks.unit: 10 persistence tests passed, including legacy/partial/full profile roundtrips, invalid profile decoding and encoding, undefined omission, all starter templates, leap day/DST and packed date boundaries, preview isolation, stale edits/deletes, and pinned legacy snapshots.
checks.emulator: 14 tests passed. Both legacy and fully profiled maximum six-phase event/template create/update payloads fit the evaluation budget. Adversarial tests reject malformed tuple lengths, scalar types, enums, nulls and profiles on rest/milestones across creates and updates. Cloud reload tests prove metadata preservation, older stored custom-template precedence, explicit upgrade behavior and snapshot pinning. Existing ACL, metadata, concurrency, atomic pairing/deletion and calendar-boundary tests continue to pass.
checks.remaining: This extension is verified locally. Its deployment and production verification are tracked separately; the existing Annual Planner deployment is not recharacterized by this audit. Broader unchanged Firestore rules were not re-audited.

checklist.updateBypass: Both template and event create/update paths invoke the same annualPhase validator; invalid profiles are tested against all four paths.
checklist.authoritySource: Existing server-managed Central user ACL only; phase metadata cannot grant access.
checklist.businessLogic: Optional work-only metadata remains unclassified when absent; old custom definitions and event snapshots are preserved.
checklist.storageAbuse: Fixed tuple sizes of 3 or 5, finite enums, unchanged six-phase bound and other existing field limits; maximum valid records verified.
checklist.typeSafety: Profile regex matching accepts strings only; malformed scalar/map/null profile fields and wrong tuple lengths are denied. Packed range remains integer and bounded.
checklist.identityAndProvenance: Shared staff edits retain immutable creator UID/time and exact updater/server-time checks. Permission fields and access policy are unchanged.

reviewScope: Changed phase encoding/decoding and annualPhase validation for optional workStage/demand metadata; regression tests also exercise existing shared-store controls. This is not a new audit of every existing collection or permission rule.
